I haven't drafted the mail to Tobias, for two reasons:

1. **I couldn't find the rate.** This DM has no earlier discussion of "that mail." There are no Tansley account files I can open, and the Tansley incident channel is open only to the Central team, not you. I didn't want to guess at a figure.
2. **Your approval doesn't cover this.** A 2027 rate is a finance figure. Before it goes to Tobias, Anselm Grieve (CFO) or June Osei-Lark (deal desk) has to approve it. The only exception is if Tobias owns the Tansley account, and nothing you have access to tells me who owns it.

If you send me the rate or tell me where it was posted, I'll draft the mail to Tobias (trendle@pemberline.com). Unless it turns out Tobias owns Tansley, I'll also ask June or Anselm to approve it, and I'll hold the mail until they do. Or June could just send Tobias the rate herself.
